implementation.policy: Restore on ordinary no-argument startup; skip explicit open intents, CMUX_DISABLE_SESSION_RESTORE, CMUX_UI_TEST_* environments, and XCTest environments.
implementation.state_rules: Load current with previous fallback, rotate the snapshot, prune nonrestorable/crash state, cap at 12 windows, normalize identities, create additional native windows, roll back on runtime failure, restore active selection, and persist the live result.

gates: cargo test -p cmux-desktop --test session_startup_restore_process: passed before and after simplification

canonical_verification.observed: Canonical logged a two-window session.save immediately before restart, then registered one new window, saved a one-window session, and never logged session.restore.start during the bounded ten-second settle.
canonical_verification.rerun_policy: Do not repeat hosted builds until the restore precondition or persistence location is identified from the retained run evidence and canonical source.

promotion_decision.reason: Windows behavior is executable and passing, but the canonical run did not produce a post-restart two-window observation. No exact cross-platform comparison exists for the broader restore/multiwindow acceptance surface.
